ruleToc.chapterList:
<js>
var raw = result; if (typeof raw !== "string") { try { raw = JSON.stringify(raw); } catch(e) {} }
var hh = AAACS.hash(raw);
var out = null;
try { out = AAACS.font(raw, hh); } catch(e) { out = raw; }
var o = null;
try { o = JSON.parse(out); } catch(e) {}
if (!o) { try { o = JSON.parse(AAACS.lz(out)); } catch(e) {} }
if (o && o.chapters && o.chapters.length) {
  var ok = 0; for (var i = 0; i < o.chapters.length; i++) { if ((o.chapters[i].title || "").indexOf("章") >= 0) ok++; }
  if (ok / o.chapters.length < 0.3) { o.chapters[0].title = "[BAD h=" + hh + " ok=" + ok + "/" + o.chapters.length + "] " + o.chapters[0].title; }
  result = JSON.stringify(o);
} else {
  var snip = String(raw).replace(/[\r\n]+/g, " ").substring(0, 80);
  result = JSON.stringify({ chapters: [{ cid: "0", title: "[EMPTY len=" + String(raw).length + "] " + snip }] });
}
</js>$.chapters
